string.text: Guide jobs and hired escorts (paid or free high-rep) join alone. Offline squad mates are dropped (so they don't pop in); online mates stay in the world in their own squad. Max one guide and one hired escort at a time. Story companions (Fanatic, Hip, etc.) are unchanged. Optional keybind pulls companions to you (skips waiting companions and locked hostages / rescue targets). Suppresses Quick Companion Teleport and Fair Fast Travel's squad teleport bind; keep DOGMA below those in MO2, or disable them.
Press to teleport companions to your position.
